title: 鹿の目線で歩く森の朝
style: Photorealistic nature documentary footage, shot on cinema camera, natural lighting, shallow depth of field, lush Japanese deciduous forest, first-person point of view from a sika deer's eye level about 1 meter above the ground, the tip of the deer's brown furry snout occasionally visible at the bottom edge of the frame, vertical 9:16 composition, highly detailed fur and foliage, no text, no watermark, no humans
motion: first-person POV camera slowly walking forward with gentle natural head bob of a deer, realistic animal movement, smooth handheld documentary feel, photorealistic

youtube.title: 鹿の目線で歩く、森の朝
youtube.description:
もしも鹿になって森を歩いたら。リス、ウサギ、キツネ、フクロウ、イノシシ…森の仲間たちに出会う一人称ショート。
#鹿 #森 #動物 #一人称視点 #AI動画

scenes.title: 夜明けの森
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV walking along a narrow misty forest trail at dawn, golden sunbeams streaming through tall cedar and beech trees, dew on ferns, soft fog.
scenes.motion_prompt: The deer steps slowly forward along the misty trail, sunbeams shift through the trees, fog drifts.
scenes.narration: 朝だ。森が目を覚ます。今日も、僕は歩き出す。
scenes.subtitle: 朝だ。今日も、僕は歩き出す

scenes.title: 小川で水を飲む
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV looking down at a crystal-clear forest stream, the deer's brown muzzle touching the water surface creating ripples, smooth pebbles and a small trout visible underwater, mossy rocks.
scenes.motion_prompt: The deer lowers its muzzle and drinks, ripples spread across the water, a small fish darts away.
scenes.narration: 喉が渇いた。冷たい小川の水は、朝いちばんのごちそうだ。
scenes.subtitle: 冷たい小川の水は、朝のごちそう

scenes.title: リスとの出会い
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV looking up at a red squirrel sitting on a mossy oak branch holding an acorn, staring curiously at the viewer, soft morning backlight.
scenes.motion_prompt: The squirrel nibbles the acorn, twitches its tail and tilts its head at the camera.
scenes.narration: 木の上から、リスが僕を見ている。おはよう、と耳を動かす。
scenes.subtitle: リスが僕を見ている。おはよう

scenes.title: 草むらのウサギ
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV at low angle in tall green grass and wildflowers, a wild brown hare leaping away through the grass, morning light, motion.
scenes.motion_prompt: The hare hops quickly away through the grass, blades of grass sway.
scenes.narration: 足元の草むらで、ウサギが跳ねた。驚かせてごめんよ。
scenes.subtitle: 驚かせてごめんよ、ウサギくん

scenes.title: 茂みの向こうのキツネ
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV through leafy bushes, a red fox standing a few meters away on the forest floor looking back at the viewer calmly, dappled sunlight.
scenes.motion_prompt: The fox watches for a moment, then turns and trots slowly into the undergrowth.
scenes.narration: 茂みの向こうに、キツネがいた。お互い、少しだけ距離をとる。
scenes.subtitle: キツネと、少しだけ距離をとる

scenes.title: 昼寝中のフクロウ
scenes.title_en: owl dozing in a tree hollow
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV looking up at an old tree trunk with a hollow, a Ural owl dozing inside with half-closed eyes, textured bark, quiet green forest.
scenes.motion_prompt: The owl slowly blinks and ruffles its feathers, the deer walks quietly past.
scenes.narration: 木のうろでは、フクロウが昼寝中。静かに通り過ぎよう。
scenes.subtitle: フクロウは昼寝中。しーっ

scenes.title: イノシシの親子
scenes.title_en: wild boar family in the mud
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV at a muddy clearing, a mother wild boar with several striped piglets rooting in the soil, sunlight through the canopy, lively and peaceful.
scenes.motion_prompt: The striped piglets scurry around their mother, sniffing the ground playfully.
scenes.narration: ぬかるみでは、イノシシの親子が泥あそび。にぎやかだ。
scenes.subtitle: イノシシの親子が泥あそび

scenes.title: 遠くのクマ
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV from the edge of a forest overlooking a small valley, a black bear walking calmly far away on the opposite slope, wind moving the leaves, tense quiet atmosphere.
scenes.motion_prompt: The deer lifts its head and slowly turns away, leaves rustle in the wind, the distant bear keeps walking.
scenes.narration: ふと、風のにおいが変わった。遠くにクマ。そっと道を変える。
scenes.subtitle: 遠くにクマ。そっと道を変える

scenes.title: 陽だまりの草原
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV stepping out of the dark forest into a bright sunlit meadow, small songbirds flying over golden grass, blue sky, wide open space.
scenes.motion_prompt: The deer walks out into the bright meadow, songbirds take off and fly across the sky.
scenes.narration: 森を抜けると、陽だまりの草原。鳥たちが歌っている。
scenes.subtitle: 森を抜けると、陽だまりの草原

scenes.title: 仲間のもとへ
scenes.image_prompt: First-person POV approaching a small herd of sika deer grazing in a meadow at golden hour, a young fawn looking up at the viewer, warm sunset light.
scenes.motion_prompt: The fawn raises its head and walks toward the camera, the herd grazes peacefully in the warm light.
scenes.narration: 仲間たちが待っていた。今日も、この森で生きていく。
scenes.subtitle: 今日も、この森で生きていく
